thread:
Asha (CS): quick capture — Pilot 'Sprintly' flagged three product asks during onboarding. renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks, they're worried about cost spikes and lack of visibility. TL;DR: feature requests + pain points + ask for prioritization.

Asha (CS): raw items: 1) Per-route embedding TTL toggle (they want shorter TTLs for dev routes). 2) CSV export of per-route token/cost breakdown for finance. 3) Onboarding checklist UX: step missing for service-account KMS hookup -> causes stalled deployment. 4) Alert/flag in console for accounts hitting 80% of reserved capacity (they missed a surge).

Priya (PM): thanks — can you add a quick severity/impact note? renewal in ~6w makes this higher priority.

Asha (CS): severity/impact: 1) TTL toggle = medium (affects cost dev vs prod). 2) CSV export = high for their finance audit. 3) KMS hookup UX = high (blocks go-live). 4) console alert = medium-high (ops risk). Customer said they'd consider renewing if the KMS/checkout UX is fixed.

Diego (Eng): ETA/feasibility quick take: TTL toggle likely small config surface (per-route flag) — low dev. CSV export = small-medium (backend + export UI). KMS UX = potentially larger (docs + orchestration + infra checks) — needs dev & security review. Console alert = small.

Priya (PM): proposed triage: 1) KMS UX fix + docs (P0 for onboarding cohort). 2) CSV cost export (P1, ties to renewals). 3) Per-route TTL toggle (P2). 4) Console alert (P2) — but can be a smoke alert first. Thoughts?

Matt (SE): workaround notes for now: share this snippet for a manual cost export until CSV is shipped:

```
# manual per-route cost dump (pseudo)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=p.sprintly&route=dev \ 
  | jq '.per_route[] | {route, tokens, cost}' > sprintly-dev-cost.json
```

Matt (SE): also we can add a one-off onboarding call to walk them through KMS steps — Ana can run enablement.

Ana (Enablement): I can run the call tomorrow 10:30 PT. I'll draft a checklist that maps to the console steps and highlight the KMS bits. Can we surface the checklist in the onboarding modal as a short-term copy paste?

Priya (PM): good plan. I'll scope KMS UX as P0 for the cohort and open a short spike ticket for security review. Diego — can you slot a 2d spike?

Diego (Eng): I'll take spike Monday. Will post findings in this thread.

Asha (CS): customer-facing note: I'll tell Sprintly we have a plan: immediate enablement call + CSV workaround, and product is prioritizing KMS UX spike. They replied :relieved: and said they'd hold renewal discussion until after the call.

cs-bot: reminder: create ticket for "KMS onboarding checklist + console affordance" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
